description: Store image files from public URLs in the media library so the merchant can use them later. Returns the stored URL of each file. JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF, up to 20MB each. This ONLY stores the files — it attaches them to nothing. If the merchant wants a photo ON A PRODUCT, use add_product_images instead: it uploads AND attaches in one step, and doing it here first would upload the same picture twice. Use this one when they just want the file kept — a logo, a banner, a picture for later. A file uploaded here may not appear on the cabinet's Media screen, which is fed by a separate service; the file is stored and its URL works regardless.

imageUrls.description: Public URLs of the images to store
